info.name: List repository aliases in group (Early Access)

params.name: group_id
params.description: Group ID

params.name: url
params.description: Optional repository URL filter — restricts results to the canonical document containing this URL

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of alias items to return per page. A single canonical document with multiple aliases may span more than one page.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: Return records after the record identified by this cursor

params.name: ending_before
params.description: Return records before the record identified by this cursor

params.name: version
params.description: The requested version of the endpoint to process the request

items.docs:
Returns a paginated list of alias URL entries for repository assets within a group. Use the optional url filter to restrict results to a specific canonical document.

#### Required permissions

- `View Groups (group.read)`

params.description: The requested version of the endpoint to process the request

items.docs:

params.name: version

items.docs:
